The new feature changes have been moved to the staging environment. Please review and confirm.
The bug fixes have also been applied.
1. Face Recognition Feature

Added an option to enable or disable Face Recognition from Widget Settings.
First-time customers are prompted to enter their name during registration.
Customer names and facial data are securely stored using AWS Rekognition.
Returning customers are automatically recognized and greeted by name.
Unrecognized customers are guided through the new user registration flow.
Customers can update their saved name at any time.
Recognition supports minor appearance changes, including glasses and facial hair.
Face recognition works across all supported Humee instances.
AWS Rekognition Pricing (Approx.)
$1 per 1,000 images processed.
